Abhishek Kumar Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate-01 Patiala House Courts, New Delhi District: New Delhi Cr Cases 8000/2019 Food Safety Officer Vs. Sh Rajeev Kumar Gupta. Judgment (a) Serial number of the case : 8000-2019 (b) Name of the complainant : Food Safety Officer, Department of Food Safety, Govt of NCT of Delhi. (c) Name of the accused person : Rajeev Kumar Gupta s/o Sh M.P. Gupta M/s Gupta Kali Mirch Wala Opp. Khasra No. 142/352, Extended Abadi Village Kanjhawala, Delhi-81. R/o B-2/10, Phase-I, Budh Vihar, Sultanpuri C Block Delhi-86. (d) Offences charged of : U/s 51 and 59 (i) of FSS Act (e) Plea of the accused : Pleaded not guilty (f) Final Judgment : Accused stands acquitted. (g) Date of institution of case : 11.09.2019 (h) Date of final arguments : 29.05.2024 (i) Date of Judgment : 30.05.2024 Cr. Case 8000-2019 FSO vs Rajeev Kumar Gupta Page No. 1 of 12
texts.facts: The present complaint has been filed by the Food Safety Department through Food Safety Officer under Section 26 of the Food Safety & Standards Act, 2006 (hereinafter referred to as the 'Act') against the accused for the violation of the provision under section 26 (1) & 26 (2) (i) r/w section 3 (1) (zz) (v) & (vii) and Section 26 (2) (i) r/w section 3 (1) (zx) of the FSS Act r/w Regulation 2.9.15.1 of the Food Safety & Standards (Food Product & Additive) Regulations, 2011, punishable under section 59 (i) & 51 of the FSS Act, 2006. Thereafter, cognizance of the offences was taken and summons were issued to the accused. Thereafter, notice was framed against the accused for the offence u/s 51 & 59 (i) of the FSS Act, 2006 to which the accused pleaded not guilty and claimed trial.
texts.arguments: 14. On the other hand, Ld SPP has submitted that the department has proved the case beyond reasonable doubt and benefit of the new Regulation cannot be extended to the accused as the sample was lifted prior to the Amendment.
